title: Chart quiz #8
caption:
Chart quiz #8. How many can you get right?

Q1: Real or fake breakout?
Q2: Which candle was the warning?
Q3: Pullback, or reversal?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Breakout #Candlesticks #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Breakouts, candles and pullbacks. Question one. Price just closed above resistance. Real breakout, or fake? Real. Volume surged on the break, and when price came back to test the level, it held. Even real breakouts can still fail. Question two. After a long run up, three candles are marked. Which one was the warning sign? A, B, or C? B. A big red candle swallowed the one before it, at the top of a long run, on heavy volume. One candle is never a guarantee, but it's a clue worth respecting. Question three. A strong uptrend, and now price is dipping toward its average. Is this a pullback, or a reversal? A pullback. Volume dried up on the dip, and it held above the last higher low. A reversal usually breaks that low. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
